title: Core-FP8 expert bytes and FP8 projections checked against K3.25-v1; CuteAFD source audit
question: Are the Core-FP8 checkpoint's bytes what its provenance says relative to K3.25-v1, and does CuteAFD v3.0.1 share, in source, the vLLM-engine issues D1-D7 and E1 found in earlier evaluation?

goals.headline: KL from BF16: fidelity set 0.0485 [0.0411, 0.0547], teacher panel 0.0476 [0.0364, 0.0605]; farther than each of the four by +0.0124 to +0.0183 on the fidelity set and +0.0155 to +0.0179 on the teacher panel (b - a, k325-fp8 as b); all 20 intervals exclude 0. Second launch identical (15,104 of 15,104). Passes the engine's fidelity gate on point estimates; the upper end of its KL interval (0.0547) is above the 0.05 threshold.
